subject: Fix three cross-check failures in UBCa ProtoBrane evaluator
description: Fixed 24 of 80 cross-check mismatches (from 80 to 56). All 66 existing unit tests pass. The remaining 56 mismatches are due to deeper evaluation model differences between UBC and ProtoBrane (forward references, SF/SFF semantics, scope chain differences) that require significant architectural work beyond the scope of the original task description.
